description: This file defines configuration types, default settings, and functions for resolving and validating configuration options in a Playwright-based testing environment. It includes handling of CLI options, environment variables, and file-based configs, as well as utility functions for parsing and sanitizing input.

classes.name: CLIOptions
classes.description: Type defining command-line interface options for configuring the Playwright environment.

classes.name: FullConfig
classes.description: Type representing the complete configuration object used internally, extending basic Config with additional properties.

classes.name: ViewportSize
classes.description: Type for viewport dimensions with width and height.

methods.name: resolveConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously merges default and provided configs to produce a full configuration object.

methods.name: resolveCLIConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and merges CLI options, environment variables, and config files into a full configuration.

methods.name: validateConfig
methods.description: Validates the configuration, ensuring referenced files exist and constraints are met.

methods.name: configFromCLIOptions
methods.description: Converts CLI options into a partial configuration object.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads a JSON configuration file asynchronously.

methods.name: outputDir
methods.description: Determines the output directory based on config and client info.

methods.name: outputFile
methods.description: Generates a file path within the output directory, ensuring directory exists.

methods.name: resolveFile
methods.description: Resolves a filename to an absolute path within the output directory, sanitizing as needed.

methods.name: pickDefined
methods.description: Utility to pick defined properties from an object.

methods.name: mergeConfig
methods.description: Merges base configuration with overrides, handling nested objects.

methods.name: semicolonSeparatedList
methods.description: Parses a semicolon-separated string into a string array.

methods.name: commaSeparatedList
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string into a string array.

methods.name: dotenvFileLoader
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a dotenv file.

methods.name: numberParser
methods.description: Converts a string to a number, or undefined if invalid.

methods.name: resolutionParser
methods.description: Parses resolution strings like '800x600' into width and height.

methods.name: headerParser
methods.description: Parses header strings into key-value pairs.

methods.name: enumParser
methods.description: Validates a string against a set of allowed options.

methods.name: envToBoolean
methods.description: Converts environment variable string to boolean.

methods.name: envToString
methods.description: Trims and returns environment variable string.

methods.name: sanitizeForFilePath
methods.description: Sanitizes a string for safe use in file paths by replacing special characters.
